hooks.command: guard="${CLAUDE_TMUX_GUARD:-$HOME/.local/bin/claude-tmux-guard}"; if [ ! -x "$guard" ]; then echo "claude-tmux-guard not found (set CLAUDE_TMUX_GUARD or install the dotfiles link); refusing to run unguarded" >&2; exit 2; fi; "$guard"; status=$?; if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then echo "claude-tmux-guard failed (exit $status); refusing to run unguarded" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
